af004_description: next-work-items.json has product items with agent_can_execute=True even when next_action says 'Authorized git commit + push (requires user authorization)'
root_cause: generate_next_work_items() always called _make_task_adjudication_fields('[agent-owned]', title) for all product items, never checking next_action text

fixes_applied.effect: Pattern-based detection of commit/push/Gate/publication wording in next_action

fixes_applied.change: generate_next_work_items() now checks _next_action_requires_external_gate(product.get('next_action', '')) for both commercial_net_products and foss_reduced_products loops (lines 797-799, 822-824)
fixes_applied.effect: Products with commit/push/Gate next_action get label='[external-gate]' instead of '[agent-owned]'

fixes_applied.change: _make_task_adjudication_fields() now short-circuits when label='[external-gate]': sets agent_can_execute=False, execution_status='external-gate-pending', bypasses adjudicator title-based re-derivation (lines 727-736)
fixes_applied.effect: Adjudicator no longer overrides an explicit [external-gate] label back to agent-owned due to generic task title

product_item_with_commit_push_next_actio.note: UNSAFE: agent would attempt git commit + push autonomously
SAFE: agent correctly stops and waits for human authorization
